title: 50 storey residential tower, Brisbane CBD: passive fire
workplace: 50 storey residential tower with foyer and 3 level basement carpark, Brisbane CBD
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Fire stopping penetrations
swms.task: Fire stop penetrations in the risers, ceilings and walls with fire collars, mastics and fire rated batts, from scissor lifts and platform ladders.

facts.fallControl: Risers are screened at each level with only the section being worked on opened, and scissor lifts with guardrails are used for all work above 2 m.
facts.safetyDataSheet: Safety data sheets for the fire rated mastic and sealant and the batts are kept at the work area: avoid skin contact, wear gloves, eye protection and a P2 respirator when cutting batts.

rules.source: Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 (Qld) s 79, s 306F
rules.quote: secured plywood covers can be unsecured to gain access and not re-secured
